description: The chunking comparison's indexes: every built dataset but LiteraryQA, which has no evidence spans, each chunking method over its own rendering, no augmentation, bge-m3. Markdown and HTML methods run only on datasets with that rendering. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m experiments.ingest experiments/configs/ingest_chunking.json

chunk_embedding.description: A safeguard: every method here caps chunks at 1,024 tokens, far below bge-m3's limit of 8,192, counted with its own tokenizer.
